Lost Ark Power Guide

What Makes Your Character Stronger

A rough priority order for where to spend time and gold. The left column moves the needle the most — work down that list before chasing anything on the right.

Big Effect

  1. DPS Uptime (Raid Knowledge + Good Skill Rotation)
  2. Ark Grid (+17 Points to fully activate the Ark Grid Cores)
  3. Ark Grid Passive Effects (Boss Damage → Additional Damage → Atk. Power)
  4. Ark Passive and Karma (Reaching Rank 6)
  5. Good Engravings
  6. Weapon Honing (Aiming for +25)
  7. Armor Honing
  8. Skill Levels +13 or +14 (Solid damage increase to skills)
  9. High Engraving Quality (Relic)
  10. Weapon Quality
  11. Accessory Effect (Outgoing Damage 2%, Weapon Power 3%)
  12. Bracelet Stats
  13. Gems
  14. Card Set
  15. Proper Synergy

Small Effect

  • Skill Runes
  • Battle Items
  • Card Collection Bonus
  • Pet Effect
  • Skin Basic Effect (1% Epic, 2% Legendary skin)
  • Roster Level
  • Paradise Orb
  • Food

Horizontal Content

Completing Horizontal Content also provides a significant increase to your character's strength.

Positional Attack

Skills carry a position tag — hover over a skill in-game to see whether it's tagged Back Attack or Front Attack. Landing the hit from the matching position applies these bonuses.

Back Attack

  • Crit Rate Bonus+10% Crit Rate
  • Outgoing Damage Bonus+5% Outgoing Damage
  • Stagger / Weak PointNone
Must hit from behind with a skill tagged Back Attack

Front Attack

  • Crit Rate BonusNone
  • Outgoing Damage Bonus+20% Outgoing Damage
  • Stagger / Weak PointImproved Stagger / Weak Point
Must hit from the front with a skill tagged Front Attack
